title: 새벽 3시, 컵라면 두 개
logline: 매일 새벽 3시에 컵라면 하나를 사 가던 할아버지가 오늘은 두 개를 산다.
style: photorealistic cinematic still, 35mm film look, shallow depth of field, low-key lighting, muted teal shadows with warm sodium highlights, subtle film grain, vertical 9:16, no text, no watermark
place: a small Korean convenience store at 3 AM, cold fluorescent lights, heavy rain streaking the large front window, a window-side bar table with two stools

characters.grandpa: an elderly Korean man in his late 70s, short white hair under a worn dark-gray flat cap, deep smile lines, thin wire-rimmed glasses, faded brown knit cardigan over a plain white shirt, weathered hands
characters.alba: a Korean man in his mid 20s, short black hair, tired eyes, green-and-white convenience store vest over a gray hoodie, name tag on the vest

shots.scene: exterior wide shot of the convenience store glowing in the dark rainy street, wet asphalt reflecting the sign
interior wide shot of the empty store, rows of shelves, cold light, nobody in sight, rain on the window

shots.text: 그런데 매일 정확히 3시에 오는 사람이 있었다.
shots.scene: extreme close-up of a wall clock showing exactly 3:00 above the counter, shallow focus
the glass front door seen from inside the store, a blurred figure silhouette pushing it open, rain behind

shots.text: 하얀 머리에 낡은 모자를 쓴 할아버지.
shots.scene: medium close-up of the old man standing just inside the door, rain drops on his cap, calm tired expression
over-the-shoulder shot from behind the old man as his hand takes a single cup noodle from the shelf

shots.text: 천오백 원을 한 장씩 세어서 건넸다.
shots.scene: close-up of the old man's weathered hands counting coins and crumpled bills onto the counter, the clerk's vest visible blurred behind

shots.text: 그는 창가에 앉아 혼자 먹었다. 말없이.
shots.scene: wide shot of the old man sitting alone at the window bar table eating cup noodles, steam rising, empty stool beside him, rain outside
over-the-shoulder shot from behind the clerk at the counter looking toward the old man eating alone by the window, soft focus
close-up of the clock again at 3:00 with a faint reflection of the rainy window, time-lapse feeling
the glass front door in heavier rain, lightning-pale light, the old man's shape approaching outside

shots.text: 그는 컵라면을 두 개 들고 왔다.
shots.scene: close-up of the old man's hands placing two cup noodles on the counter side by side
close-up of the young clerk's face, eyes widening slightly in surprise, cold light on one side
two-shot across the counter, the clerk seen from behind and the old man facing the camera, a small curious pause
close-up of the old man's face, a gentle small smile forming, eyes glistening, warm light on his cheek
tight close-up of the old man speaking softly, shallow depth of field, rain blur in the background
very close shot of the old man's eyes behind thin glasses, a tear about to fall, cold teal light
the young clerk's back and shoulders at the counter, head slightly lowered, the cold store stretching empty in front of him

shots.text: 그래서 대신, 뜨거운 물을 두 컵 부었다.
shots.scene: close-up of the clerk's hands pouring hot water from a kettle into two cup noodles, thick steam rising in the cold light
wide shot at the window table, the old man on one stool and a steaming cup noodle placed at the empty stool across from him, rain streaking the glass
side profile of the old man looking at the cup across from him, soft steam in front of his face, eyes wet, warm light
wide exterior shot through the rain-streaked window, two glowing cups on the bar table and the old man's silhouette, the only warm light on a dark street

shots.text: 다음 날에도, 그다음 날에도, 나는 3시를 기다렸다.
shots.scene: the clock at 3:00 again, the empty front door in the background, nobody coming in, quiet and lonely
the empty window bar table with two empty stools, rain still falling outside, cold light, no one there

shots.text: 그래서 오늘도 나는, 컵라면 두 개에 물을 붓는다.
shots.scene: close-up of the clerk's hands pouring hot water into two cup noodles on the bar table at night, steam curling up

shots.text: 혹시 몰라서. 아니, 그냥… 보고 싶어서.
shots.scene: exterior wide shot of the convenience store at the first blue light of dawn, rain easing, warm window glow with two small cups visible on the table
